name: LIR S.r.l.
note: Italian investment holding company based in Montebelluna (TV). Per Geox S.p.A.'s half-year 2026 financial report, LIR holds 71.16% of Geox S.p.A. and belongs entirely to Mario Moretti Polegato (85%) and Enrico Moretti Polegato (15%). The same report names Diadora S.p.A. as an affiliated company of the Geox group.
